sentences.en: There is a mass of dark clouds in the sky.
sentences.zh: 天空中聚集着大量的乌云。

sentences.en: A little bird told me you are not attending Mass.

sentences.en: Writings by ethnic minorities begin to reach a critical mass.
sentences.zh: 少数民族的作品开始达到临界数量了。
